gemrock.name: Gem rock
gemrock.ex: A dense outcrop threaded with uncut gems. Mining level 40 required.

fishing.name: Fishing spot
fishing.ex: A quiet pool where shrimp gather.

trout_fishing.name: Trout run
trout_fishing.ex: A fast current where trout rise. Requires a fly rod, feathers, and Fishing level 20.

salmon_fishing.name: Salmon run
salmon_fishing.ex: Deep, cold water where salmon run. Requires a fly rod, feathers, and Fishing level 30.

pike_fishing.name: Pike pool
pike_fishing.ex: A quiet deep pool. Requires a fishing rod, bait, and Fishing level 25.

bait_fishing.name: Bait shoal
bait_fishing.ex: Sardines gather here; herring may bite at Fishing level 10. Requires a fishing rod and bait.

willow.name: Willow tree
willow.ex: A drooping willow by the pond. Requires Woodcutting level 30.

well.name: Wishing well
well.ex: The town well. Locals pray here for luck.

stall.name: Village merchant
stall.ex: Sell gathered goods and buy supplies. A busy display of market goods.

furnace.name: Smelting furnace
furnace.ex: Smelt copper and tin into bronze.

anvil.name: Smithing anvil
anvil.ex: Forge bars into weapons and tools.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.ex: Cook food or burn logs into charcoal.

board.name: Village job board
board.ex: Complete real gathering and crafting jobs for rewards.

yew.name: Yew tree
yew.ex: A dark, ancient yew. Requires Woodcutting level 60.

magic.name: Magic tree
magic.ex: It hums with power. Requires Woodcutting level 75.
